summary: Centrus Energy filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $500 million capital raise: 500,000 Class A shares at $199.64, 2,005,513 pre-funded warrants at $199.54 (strike $0.10), and 6,992,382 common warrants in four series struck at $226.8625, $272.2350, $317.6075 and $362.9800, each divided into tranches expiring on anniversaries of the September 10, 2026 trade date; per-share pricing implies an 8.8% premium to the $181.49 last sale. Net proceeds before expenses are $490 million, with up to $2 billion more if warrants are fully exercised. Watch warrant overhang and potential dilution.
